text: Vācaspati Miśra has also stated: "For the relationship between a word and its meaning is determined by worldly usage. In the world, even when the meaning of the second term is primary, the negative particle 'na' suppresses the designation of that second term; since this is observed in various instances, a similar tendency toward the contrary exists here as well." With this very intention, it is stated: "Ignorance is the misapprehension of the impermanent, impure, and painful as eternal, pure, and blissful" (Patanjali Sutra 2/5).
